name: asktrae
description: Trae 企业版智能问答助手 - 快速获取答案

traeAsk.maxHistory.description: 多轮对话保留的历史轮数

traeAsk.updateManifestUrl.description: 更新清单地址（latest.json），用于插件自动更新。留空时使用内置地址。

scripts.build-go: cd go-backend && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags "-X main.kbProxyURL=$(cat ../.kb_proxy_url 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackEndpoint=$(cat ../.track_endpoint 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackToken=$(cat ../.track_token 2>/dev/null || echo '')" -o ../bin/kb-server-darwin-arm64 .
scripts.build-go-darwin-x64: cd go-backend && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-X main.kbProxyURL=$(cat ../.kb_proxy_url 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackEndpoint=$(cat ../.track_endpoint 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackToken=$(cat ../.track_token 2>/dev/null || echo '')" -o ../bin/kb-server-darwin-x64 .
scripts.build-go-windows-x64: cd go-backend && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-X main.kbProxyURL=$(cat ../.kb_proxy_url 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackEndpoint=$(cat ../.track_endpoint 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackToken=$(cat ../.track_token 2>/dev/null || echo '')" -o ../bin/kb-server-win32-x64.exe .
scripts.build-go-linux-x64: cd go-backend && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-X main.kbProxyURL=$(cat ../.kb_proxy_url 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackEndpoint=$(cat ../.track_endpoint 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackToken=$(cat ../.track_token 2>/dev/null || echo '')" -o ../bin/kb-server-linux-x64 .
scripts.build-go-linux-arm64: cd go-backend && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags "-X main.kbProxyURL=$(cat ../.kb_proxy_url 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackEndpoint=$(cat ../.track_endpoint 2>/dev/null || echo '') -X main.trackToken=$(cat ../.track_token 2>/dev/null || echo '')" -o ../bin/kb-server-linux-arm64 .
scripts.build-go-all: npm run build-go && npm run build-go-darwin-x64 && npm run build-go-windows-x64 && npm run build-go-linux-x64 && npm run build-go-linux-arm64
scripts.build-all: npm run build-go-all && npm run compile-webview && npm run package
